edges.reason: _transfer uses tx.origin to index the per-block transfer delay map.
tx.origin is written into _holderLastTransferTimestamp permitting one purchase per block.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime.
_transfer compares block.timestamp to lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency to trigger auto burn.
manual burn cooldown requirement depends on block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records block.timestamp as the new lastLpBurnTime.
auto burn writes lastLpBurnTime used by later timestamp checks.
manual burn writes lastManualLpBurnTime enforcing the cooldown.
_transfer invokes swapBack when swap thresholds and guards are satisfied.
The swapping guard is set and cleared around the swapBack call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth for the amount to liquidate.
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the liquidity tokens and residual ETH.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call.
swapBack sends ETH to devWallet with a low-level call, allowing reentrant execution.
swapBack forwards the remaining contract ETH to marketingWallet with a low-level call.
swapBack reads devWallet as the recipient of ethForDev.
swapBack reads marketingWallet as the recipient of the residual balance.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity during share computation.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing during share computation.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev during share computation.
swapBack caps the contract balance using swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer consults automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFees to skip fee accounting.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on non-excluded recipients.
_transfer triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on qualifying sells.
limitsInEffect gates the anti-whale and delay checks.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block purchase restriction.
tradingActive gates transfers for non-excluded accounts.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens invokes the external pair.sync() call.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens invokes the external pair.sync() call.

The from parameter drives zero-address, exclusion and AMM classification checks.
The to parameter drives zero-address, maxWallet and sell-side fee logic.
The amount parameter feeds limit comparisons and fee calculations.
The newNum parameter is validated then scaled into maxTransactionAmount.
swapBack derives liquidityTokens from the accumulated liquidity share.
swapBack derives amountToSwapForETH from the balance minus liquidity tokens.
swapBack derives ethForLiquidity as ETH minus marketing and dev shares.
amountToSwapForETH is forwarded to swapTokensForEth.
liquidityTokens is forwarded to addLiquidity.
ethForLiquidity is forwarded to addLiquidity.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens computes amountToBurn as pair balance times percent divided by 10000.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to serve the overridden _transfer flow analysis.
The to parameter only exists to serve the overridden _transfer flow analysis.
The amount parameter is consumed entirely by _transfer limit and fee arithmetic.
The percent parameter is only used to scale the burn inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
The newNum parameter is only used to assign maxTransactionAmount in updateMaxTxnAmount.
liquidityTokens is a temporary that flows straight into addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is a temporary that flows straight into swapTokensForEth.
ethForLiquidity is a temporary that flows straight into addLiquidity.
amountToBurn is a temporary computed and consumed inside autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
